{{Quote|Your third stop brings you to the peaceful world of Alderaan, where you can relax in a natural wonderland. Recently voted "Safest Planet in the Galaxy" by ''Hyperspace Traveler''.|Star Tours commercial|<ref name="COM" />}}
'''''Hyperspace Traveler''''' was a magazine focused on [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] travel.<ref name="COM" /> At some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="DroidsLookingFor">{{DPB|url=2010/09/these-are-the-droids-youre-looking-for|text=These ARE the Droids You're Looking For!|author=[[Tom Fitzgerald]]}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] world<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was voted "Safest [[Planet/Legends|Planet]] in the Galaxy" by ''Hyperspace Traveler''. This award was used as an advertising argument by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency in one of their commercials.<ref name="COM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The magazine ''Hyperspace Traveler'' was mentioned in a [[in-universe]] commercial created for the queue area of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''&mdash;a reimagined [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction in [[Disneyland]] and [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]].<ref name="WhereInSpace">{{DPB|url=2010/08/new-star-tours-video-makes-us-ask-where-will-the-new-star-tours-attraction-take-us|text=New Star Tours Video Makes Us Ask: Where Will the New Star Tours Attraction Take Us?}}</ref>
